spanish: Su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: סֹלֶת is a common noun; sólet leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
Qal passive of mix/mingle is rendered as kneaded (amasada).
מִנְחָה is a common noun; minjá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.

notes: Counts, suffixes, construct vs absolute plata, and both שֶׁקֶל tokens match the packet.
